Section: Summary of 1st article (use proper citation, discuss relevant findings)
Feedback: Don't just start this with summary of article one – carry on where the purpose paragraph left off smoothly. Start with the big picture and work down into details. The best way to think about it: when I get to your RHs there is a hypothesized correlation/mean difference AND a direction/higher mean – HOW did you arrive at each of those conclusions and WHY is that logic supported by your refs?

Feedback: You need to talk about what those results mean (each of them!), what nonsignificant findings might suggest, and why they might have been nonsignificant. Section: What has this study contributed to psychological science?
Feedback: Because you tested these things, we know more about them… specify what exactly. If you had nonsignificant results, think about reasons why (power problem? demographics?). Showing that a previous finding isn't replicating and suggesting why IS a contribution.

Feedback: Walk the reader through your logic step by step. Tie the references to your analyses, then to the natural extension that is your proposal.
